title: Maximum Amount of Money Robot Can Earn
summary: Given an m x n grid, a robot starts at (0, 0) and aims to reach (m - 1, n - 1).
statement: Given an m x n grid, a robot starts at (0, 0) and aims to reach (m - 1, n - 1). It can move right or down. Each cell contains coins[i][j]: positive coins are gained, negative coins represent robbers who steal the absolute value. The robot can neutralize robbers in at most 2 cells to prevent them from stealing. Return the maximum profit the robot can achieve.
constraints: coins has at most 500 rows and columns with values in -1,000..1,000.
Move only right or down from the top-left to bottom-right cell.
Collect cell values, but optionally neutralize the loss at up to two negative cells; maximize final money.
hints: Path position and neutralizations used fully determine future choices.
Keep three best values per cell, one for each used-neutralization count.
Transition from above or left by taking the cell value, and for a negative cell optionally advance the neutralization state without adding it.
Every path/state has one predecessor, so maximizing both transition types considers every legal strategy.

tests.explanation: Following the best path and neutralizing useful robbers yields eight.
Neutralize the robber in the only cell to finish with zero.
